en: Vintage Hungarian postcard. The front shows a monochrome sketch of a narrow street with tall buildings leading toward a Baroque-style church with a tower and dome; pedestrians are visible in the foreground. Below the image is the caption "EGYETEMI TEMPLOM." The reverse side has standard postcard layout with address lines and stamp box, printed in Hungarian, and a heading indicating Pécs Lyceum Church and the artist's name.
